title: pr-pane 0.3.4: make the /prs autoOpen shell hint pasteable
summary: The 0.3.3 hint's <marketplace> placeholder is a shell redirect when pasted, and the bare form prints the invalid value true|false.
description: A code review of the v0.3.3 catalog bump (evolv-marketplace) found that pasting 'claude plugin configure pr-pane@<marketplace> --values-stdin' into bash or zsh redirects stdin from a missing file named marketplace and writes stdout to a file named --values-stdin, and that the bare form's {"autoOpen":"true|false"} is not a valid value. Jeremy approved the fix in the evolv-marketplace session.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every hint command is concrete and runnable as printed: pr-pane@evolv-marketplace as the id, plus one plain sentence telling other installs to use the id claude plugin list shows
The bare form prints one command to turn auto-open on and one to turn it off; enable and disable print only their own
A test fails if any hint line has <, > or | outside the leading echo pipe, or a value other than true or false
validate --strict, plugin test and tsc pass

implementationNotes: AC1/AC2: live 'claude -p --plugin-dir plugin "/prs autoOpen"' printed two concrete commands (true, then false) for pr-pane@evolv-marketplace plus the claude plugin list sentence; each printed line run in zsh with a stub claude received the JSON on stdin and args 'plugin configure pr-pane@evolv-marketplace --values-stdin', and no 'marketplace' or '--values-stdin' file was created. Tests assert enable and disable print only their own value.
AC3: expectPasteable() in tests/pane.test.ts; with INSTALL_ID set back to 'pr-pane@<marketplace>' the suite went 23 pass / 3 fail, restored it is 25/25.

Correction: the first push of PR #7 (d-commit 'pr-pane 0.3.4: make ...') did not pass tsc. expectPasteable() took string but command.run's text is string | undefined (2 errors). The AC4 note above was written before tsc had finished. Fixed in the follow-up commit (expectPasteable accepts string | undefined and asserts it is defined). After it: tsc 0 errors, 25/25, validate --strict.

Review (/code-review 7) fixes, approved by Jeremy ('proceed'): Story note updated from the 0.3.3 placeholder form; the rejected-write test now calls expectPasteable; expectPasteable checks line 0 (except an engine error line) and the full metacharacter set <>|;&$`#; hint commands are no longer indented. Each regression was mutation-tested: indent, a <marketplace> id, and a $MARKET id each turn the suite 23 pass / 3 fail. Restored: 25/25, tsc 0 errors, validate --strict, and a live claude -p paste check in zsh.

Not changed, per triage: the hard-coded pr-pane@evolv-marketplace id (trade-off Jeremy approved; $.plugin has no install id), the unverified interactive rendering of the multi-line hint (interactive sessions reach it only when $.config.set rejects), and lore's docs/log.md recording pre-squash SHAs (lore tooling).
Distribution (checked against GitHub on 2026-10-20): v0.3.4 entered the catalog through evolv-marketplace#25 (2b7ec1f). The org library and Jeremy's install were reported at 0.3.4.
finalSummary: Shipped pr-pane 0.3.4 (PR #7, tag v0.3.4 on its squash merge). The headless /prs autoOpen hint prints concrete, unindented commands for pr-pane@evolv-marketplace that paste as printed (an on and an off line for the bare form, one line for enable and disable), plus a sentence for other installs. expectPasteable() guards all three hint sites against shell metacharacters, leading spaces and non-boolean values; mutation tests confirm it catches each regression. Verified by 25/25 tests, tsc 0 errors (after correcting an early false claim), validate --strict, CI, and a live claude -p paste check. Jeremy approved the merge and tag.
